page.title: Notes
page.purpose: Expose the removable notes example as a concrete route while the scenario's real product domain is still being shaped.

states.description: The notes surface is ready and exposes its list and create action.
Notes are loading while the notes surface remains present and announces progress.
No notes exist and the surface explains the empty state without collapsing the route.

The last note snapshot remains visible while a refresh or synchronization is pending.
